quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Electric press release: Meta, NEC and Sumitomo Electric to Collaborate on "Petal", (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Meta, NEC and Sumitomo Electric have started collaboration to build 'Petal', a transatlantic optical submarine cable system spanning approximately 7,000 km between the United States and France, scheduled to commence operation in 2029; the companies call it the world's first commercial petabit optical submarine cable system (company claim). Meta will fund and operate the cable system, NEC is responsible for the overall design and construction of the two-core system, and Sumitomo Electric will provide the two-core fiber (its '2C Z-PLUS Fiber ULL' submarine multi-core fiber). With 48 pairs of spatial channels (core-pairs), Petal is to double the transoceanic capacity of Anjana, the earlier 24 fiber-pair system from another Meta / NEC / Sumitomo Electric collaboration. No contract value or fiber volume stated.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 7,000 km US-France; operation scheduled 2029; 48 core-pairs; two-core fiber supplied by Sumitomo Electric
